reference_answer: RelayView package.json declares Node >=22.19 <23 || >=24.11 <25; its package-lock resolves @playwright/test/playwright 1.62.1 and TypeScript 5.9.3. agent-harness-evals package.json declares Node >=22.19.0 and pins native CLIs including @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.270, @openai/codex 0.144.0, opencode-ai 1.18.28, and @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 0.85.0 in package-lock. Its pyproject.toml requires Python >=3.12, pins inspect-ai 0.3.261 and inspect-evals 0.16.0, and requires uv 0.12.9. The declared Node intersection is 22.19.0 through any 22.x below 23, or 24.11.0 through any 24.x below 25. The lowest shared Node is 22.19.0. Those declarations and lockfiles do not establish successful installation, native-module compatibility, or passing tests on a given machine.
